comments.note: Auto-finalize logic is correctly placed as step 4b within the updateWorkPackageWithSync lock scope — the COMPLETE transition is atomic with the pipeline completion. The guard order (acceptance_criteria_updates applied before auto-finalize check) is explicitly documented in the inline comment.
pending_work_packages -= 1 is safe: can only reach this branch if WP is IN_PROGRESS (completion guard) so no double-decrement risk. The assumption is implicit but correct.

Medium-priority known gap: auto-finalize does NOT call propagateDependencyUnblock after transitioning WP to COMPLETE. For projects with dependent WPs, dependents will remain BLOCKED even when their dependency is now COMPLETE. Mitigated by the current linear-workflow design but must be resolved before introducing parallel WPs with dependencies. Fixing requires exporting propagateDependencyUnblock from work-package.ts. Recommend scheduling a dedicated WP.

autoFinalizeResult and unmetCriteriaList are captured via closure from inside the lock callback (same pattern as 'claimed' in begin-work.ts). Works correctly — same minor comment suggestion applies: add a brief inline note that these are written inside the lock and read after await.
